definitions: A series of covert, and at times illegal, projects conducted by the United States Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) aimed at surveilling, infiltrating, discrediting, and disrupting domestic political organizations.
The FBI program that targeted various American political groups from 1956 to 1971.
examples: The revelations about Cointelpro shocked the nation.
Many activists were victims of Cointelpro tactics.
Cointelpro aimed to neutralize perceived threats.
